reason: I travel twice a month and always forget my pills at home, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag fits how I actually live. The named lab and the batch report make me trust it more than a random TikTok Shop supplement, and $24.99 is low enough to try one box.
objection: Individual foil sachets are more packaging waste, and I have no idea if it works for me, so I would only buy one box and not two.
would_change_my_mind: If the sachets were not individually foil-wrapped, or if the batch report on the page turned out not to match the batch number, I would pass.
